task: Before planning, read kernel_src/EXPERIMENT_CONTEXT.md completely and treat it as mandatory campaign memory. Author a fresh native-HIP gfx1201 SplitKV paged-decode implementation, then use the full 16-direction optimization budget to beat the immutable live Triton SplitKV denominator. The HIP implementation must support both OCP FP8 E4M3FN and BF16 KV caches with BF16 query/output, head size 256, Hq=12, Hkv=2, GQA=6, physical page size 1568, arbitrary ragged sequence lengths, and the exact stride-padded K/V cache contract. For FP8, apply independent scalar FP32 k_scale/v_scale before BF16 dot products; BF16 caches are unscaled. The five weighted FP8 long-context/ragged cases are the primary ratio-of-sums; all captured FP8 guards plus BF16 short, page-boundary, long, and ragged cases are mandatory zero-weight gates. Time the complete attention operation with caller-owned output and scratch: allocation and JIT compilation stay outside timing. A two-dispatch stage-1 plus reduction design is acceptable; a correct fused or persistent single-dispatch design is preferred when faster. Never optimize or ship Triton as the HIP candidate, import FlyDSL/AITER/CK, call a library attention implementation, memoize outputs or operands, use persistent result reuse, exact-shape lookup tables, hidden precomputation, relaxed accuracy, or reduce case coverage. Start correctness-first with wave32 reductions and stride-based scalar/vector loads, then explore split scheduling, token tiles, GQA6 row utilization, OCP FP8 conversion/WMMA or dot strategy, LDS layouts, online softmax, producer/reducer fusion, scratch traffic, and launch overhead. Bank only reproducible gains of at least 0.5%; require rtol=atol=0.01 live parity on five fresh draws, output independence, native HIP source rebuild and dispatch engagement on every dtype/case, every zero-weight guard at least 0.98x, and a final scored FP8 speedup greater than 1.0x over frozen Triton. Record VGPR/SGPR/LDS/scratch, inspect ISA for the intended gfx1201 instructions, and finish with paired order-reversed cache-controlled timings plus CUDA-graph replay.

op_spec.implementation: native HIP SplitKV paged attention authored against frozen Triton
op_spec.routing_contract: One native HIP implementation family must cover every FP8 and BF16 manifest case without exact-shape/model routing.
op_spec.math_contract: Online softmax and cross-split merge use FP32 state. FP8 K/V are dequantized with independent scalar FP32 scales before BF16 dot products; BF16 K/V use unit scales. Output is cast once to BF16.
